objective: replace the fixed-T16 Target verify graph's per-row paged K/V updates with one exact batched update per full-attention layer and cache kind

candidate.logical_operation: for every i in [0,T), cache[target_blocks[i], offsets_in_block[i], :, :] = updates[i, :, :]

cache_input_output.aliasing: output must preserve the current in-place cache semantics

ranked_backend_experiments.reason: the supplied Ascend310P3 dispatch report exposes npu_scatter_nd_update_ with a Functionalize kernel; AIR custom-node preservation and ATC support are still unproven
use only if ScatterNdUpdate cannot retain exact cross-block batched writes or cannot survive AIR-to-OM conversion

correctness_contract.duplicate_indices: reject at the graph boundary; valid verify positions are strictly increasing

known_risks: functionalization may clone the cache or break the required alias instead of retaining one in-place device update
TorchAir may decompose the frontend back into row-wise nodes or fail to preserve a supported GE custom node
ATC may reject the selected frontend, dtype, rank, layout or cross-64-token-block indices on Ascend310P3
blocked NZ cache layout may not match generic ScatterNdUpdate's logical contiguous interpretation
duplicate-index update order is backend-dependent and therefore prohibited
source node reduction does not prove lower OM latency; only same-device msprof and no-profiler measurements can do so

checks: batched cache equals the current row-wise cache bit-for-bit
prefix and suffix sentinels are unchanged
K and V are both covered for all 8 full-attention layers
rejected physical tail is invisible after logical cursor rollback and is safely overwritten next round

export: strict torch.export succeeds without graph break
Target verify graph contains exactly 16 retained batched cache-update nodes
Target verify graph contains zero qwen35_dflash.npu_cache_update.default row-wise nodes
all other required custom nodes and the five-OM external tensor ABI remain unchanged
target: AIR export succeeds with custom-node audit
ordinary and DFlash strict-greedy token IDs and EOS are identical
K/V cache and recurrent/conv committed state pass full-state comparison
cross-block cases pass with fallback disabled and runtime/device identity recorded
three warmups plus ten no-profiler measurements show a repeatable end-to-end improvement
msprof attributes the change to lower cache-update launch or execution cost and is not used as formal latency evidence

rollback.meaning: pushed exact verify-index hoist with the existing 256 row-wise CacheUpdate nodes and unchanged OM ABI

claim_boundary: This file is an approval proposal only. It does not claim implementation, AIR/OM conversion, target correctness, or latency improvement.
